meta.title: Biotech Library Journal List
meta.user_agent: Biotechnology-Evolution-Library/0.1 (academic journal curation; polite research bot)
meta.selection_criteria: Curated by subject relevance and standing, then verified against OpenAlex. Citedness is OpenAlex 2-year mean citedness only, not Journal Impact Factor. OA flags are OpenAlex is_oa / is_in_doaj, not a licence audit. Display names and publishers are recorded as OpenAlex returned them.

subjects.name: Flagship multidisciplinary
subjects.note: Not a single biotechnology subject. These are widely read science and life-science venues that often publish high-impact biotech papers. Included so the dashboard can watch them as well as the specialist journals.

subjects.name: General biotechnology
subjects.note: Core biotechnology journals, including reviews and applied titles.

subjects.name: Nanobiotechnology
subjects.note: Nanoscience journals that regularly publish biological, medical or bio-related nano work, plus dedicated nanobiotech titles.

subjects.name: Food technology
subjects.note: Food science, food chemistry, food microbiology and food bioprocess journals.

subjects.name: Microbiology
subjects.note: General, environmental and pathogenic microbiology, including several fully OA society and BMC titles. Frontiers in Microbiology is a high-volume OA venue.

subjects.name: Biochemistry
subjects.note: Core biochemistry, chemical biology, structural biology and proteomics. Biochemistry is the ACS journal (ISSN-L 0006-2960). Biochemical Journal is the current Portland Press title (ISSN-L 0264-6021), not the ceased historic records.

subjects.name: Bioprocess engineering
subjects.note: Bioprocess, biochemical engineering and closely related chemical-engineering venues.

subjects.name: Industrial biotechnology
subjects.note: Metabolic engineering, microbial cell factories, industrial microbes, green chemistry and bio-based production.

subjects.name: Enzymes and enzyme technology
subjects.note: Dedicated enzyme and biocatalysis journals, plus leading catalysis titles that also publish biocatalysis. Nature Catalysis and ACS Catalysis are broader than enzymes alone.

subjects.name: Molecular biology and genetics
subjects.note: Molecular biology, genetics and core nucleic-acid journals. Genetics is the Genetics Society of America journal now hosted by OUP (ISSN-L 0016-6731), not Nature Genetics.

subjects.name: Cell biology
subjects.note: Cell, developmental and organelle biology, plus a stem-cell title that also appears under tissue engineering.

journals.display_name: Annual Review of Cell and Developmental Biology

subjects.name: Immunology
subjects.note: Fundamental, translational and clinical immunology. The Journal of Allergy and Clinical Immunology is more clinical than the rest of the list. OpenAlex citedness for The Journal of Immunology looks unreliable (see Flagged).

journals.host_organization_name: American Association for the Advancement of Science

journals.display_name: Journal of Allergy and Clinical Immunology

subjects.name: Bioinformatics and computational biology
subjects.note: Methods, algorithms, genome informatics and systems-level computation. Nature Computational Science is broader than biology alone.

subjects.name: Plant and agricultural biotechnology
subjects.note: Plant biology and crop genetics journals that are the main venues for plant biotechnology. Frontiers in Plant Science was verified as a high-volume OA venue and is listed under also considered, not in this table.

subjects.name: Environmental biotechnology
subjects.note: Environmental science, water, microbes and bioprocessing relevant to environmental biotech. Chemosphere and The Science of The Total Environment were verified but left out of this table (high-volume and very broad); see Flagged.

subjects.name: Medical and pharmaceutical biotechnology
subjects.note: Drug discovery, biologics, delivery, vaccines and translational medicine. Human Gene Therapy, Gene Therapy and Pharmaceutical Research were verified and are listed under also considered.

journals.publisher: American Association for the Advancement of Science
journals.host_organization_name: American Association for the Advancement of Science

subjects.name: Synthetic biology
subjects.note: Dedicated synbio titles plus metabolic, systems and chemical-biology venues that publish a large share of the field. Synthetic Biology here is the OUP journal (ISSN-L 2397-7000), not ACS Synthetic Biology.

subjects.name: Tissue engineering and biomaterials
subjects.note: Added as a major biotech subject not named in the first subject list. Advanced Materials is included even though OpenAlex does not report a publisher (see Flagged).

subjects.name: Genomics and systems biology
subjects.note: Added as a major subject overlapping molecular biology and bioinformatics, with a stronger focus on genomes and systems.
